calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n_rows,
       count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_distinct,
       count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load,
       sum(closing_units) AS units
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-30' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (s.store_id, p.sku)) AS n_nat,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id >= 900) AS n_900plus,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test') AS n_test,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE fs.closing_units < 0) AS n_neg,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE fs.closing_units IS NULL) AS n_null,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.is_current = false) AS n_noncurrent_prod,
       count(DISTINCT p.category) AS n_cat_asof, count(DISTINCT cp.category) AS n_cat_current,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.category <> cp.category) AS n_cat_changed,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE fs.closing_value <> fs.closing_units * p.standard_unit_cost) AS n_value_mismatch,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.valid_to < DATE '2026-09-27' OR s.valid_from > DATE '2026-09-27') AS n_store_ver_off,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.close_date IS NOT NULL) AS n_closed_store,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.delisted_on IS NOT NULL) AS n_delisted
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_rl,
       count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id >= 900) AS n_900plus,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id = 999) AS n_999,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test') AS n_test,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.quantity <= 0) AS n_nonpos_qty,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.staff_purchase_flag) AS n_staff,
       min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd, sum(f.quantity) AS units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20'

WITH ranged AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, p.sku FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27'
),
sold AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, p.sku, cp.category, f.quantity
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT sold.category, sum(quantity) AS units_all,
       sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE r.sku IS NOT NULL) AS units_ranged,
       sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE r.sku IS NULL) AS units_not_ranged
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ranged r ON r.store_id = sold.store_id AND r.sku = sold.sku
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending),
closing AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold_4w
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, c.category,
       c.closing_units, ROUND(s.units_sold_4w / 4.0, 1) AS avg_weekly_units_sold,
       ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_sold_4w / 4.0), 1) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM closing c LEFT JOIN sold s ON s.category = c.category
ORDER BY c.category
